evidence_policy: All source code claims, institutional actions and timestamps require direct source links. Unverified entries are hypotheses, not findings.

institutional_timeline.note: Exact publication time must be sourced
No globally uniform CAB authorization exists
No universal enterprise fleet completion timestamp

nelson_model.rules: Patch SLAs, disclosure practices and change controls vary by institution; no universal 24 hour requirement established.
nelson_model.actors: PHP maintainers, distributors, hosting operators, enterprise SecOps, public institutions and users.
nelson_model.interests: Security, availability, operational cost, accountability and reputation.
nelson_model.power: Centralized operators may deploy changes across managed fleets; decentralized operators have distinct approval and dependency constraints.
nelson_model.options: Vendor release, verified distribution backport, temporary containment with documented residual risk.
nelson_model.commitments: Assign accountable owner, change authorization and independent verification.
nelson_model.adaptation: Compare actual timestamped disclosure, authorization, remediation and verification records; do not infer elapsed hours.
